name: 1.2 Read the feedback call and save it in the teacher sheet

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?fields=files(id,name)&q=' + encodeURIComponent("trashed=false and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name='Updated plans' and '" + $json.parents[0] + "' in parents") }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ action: 'process', inputs: { transcript: $('Prepare call').item.json.transcript, collected_data: $('Prepare call').item.json.collected_data, summary: $('Prepare call').item.json.summary, plan_rows: $json.plan_rows, call_date: $('Prepare call').item.json.call_date }, context: { channel: 'elevenlabs_voice', conversation_id: $('Prepare call').item.json.conversation_id } }) }}

nodes.name: Run 1.3 Update the next days' plan

assignments.name: el
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Prepare call').item.json.collected_data || {}; return { day_number: d.day_number ?? null, topic: d.topic ?? null, class_happened: d.class_happened ?? null, completed: d.completed ?? null, group_a_result: d.group_a_result ?? null, group_b_result: d.group_b_result ?? null, group_c_result: d.group_c_result ?? null, what_went_well: d.what_went_well ?? null, what_went_wrong: d.what_went_wrong ?? null, how_to_improve: d.how_to_improve ?? null, what_is_left: d.what_is_left ?? null, other_notes: d.other_notes ?? null }; })() }}
